MET-001.problem: A page has no title or more than one, an empty or too long one, or the same title as another page.

MET-002.problem: A page has no description for search results, an empty or too long one, or one shared with another page.

MET-004.problem: A page title or description is shorter or longer than search results show well.

SE-202.problem: A page title or description is too short for Bing to use well.

MET-003.problem: A page has no main heading, more than one, or headings that skip a level.

IDX-001.problem: The page list for search engines does not match the pages that exist and should be found.

IDX-002.problem: The page list for search engines is broken, too big, has repeated entries, or mixes sites.

IDX-003.problem: Many pages in the page list share one update time that is only when the site was built.

IDX-004.problem: The file that guides search engines is missing, skips the page list, or blocks pages that should be found.

SE-001.problem: The file that guides search engines cannot be read properly, or is the wrong type, too big or garbled.

SE-004.problem: A date in the page list for search engines has no time of day, is not valid, or lies in the future.

URL-009.problem: A page's official address is missing, is wrong, or disagrees with the address stated elsewhere on it.

LNK-002.problem: A link inside the site is broken, tells search engines to ignore it, or uses a second address for a page.

A11-007.problem: An image has no description for people who cannot see it, or the description is a file name or just image.

PRF-001.problem: A page is slow to show its content, shifts around, or is slow to respond on a phone.

PRF-016.problem: The server is slow to start answering when a page is first asked for.

SCH-001.problem: A page's hidden description for search engines is missing, broken, or leaves out the business or the page.

PMP-001.problem: A question buyers ask AI engines is not answered by any page, and no reason is given.

DSN-001.problem: A page uses looping, pulsing, bouncing or shimmering motion.

DSN-002.problem: A page uses gradient text, or a background that fades between two different colours.

DSN-003.problem: A heading, button or link label contains an emoji.

DSN-004.problem: A label is in capital letters with wide letter spacing.

DSN-005.problem: The page text uses hype words such as seamless, unlock or AI-powered.

DSN-006.problem: A heading contains an exclamation mark.

DSN-007.problem: A heading starts with a greeting such as Hello or Welcome.

DSN-008.problem: A badge on the page says PRO or Beta.

DSN-009.problem: The page text makes a claim such as loved by thousands or ten times faster that cannot be checked.

DSN-010.problem: Small text is set in a heavy bold weight, which is hard to read.

DSN-011.problem: Small text has its letters squeezed too tightly together.

ENV-001.problem: A preview could be found by search engines, or a live page is hidden from them.

SEC-010.problem: A page is sent without the safety settings that browsers expect, or with weak ones.

SEC-075.problem: A page lets too many sources run scripts, which weakens its protection for visitors.
